GMC (13vPnC) and corresponding 2-sided 95% CIs were evaluated. GMCs were calculated using all participants with available data after the toddler dose and after the third dose of the infant series.
agent_a_row.outcome_overview_time_frame: Toddler Dose (12 months of age)
